steps.message:
Execute: adb shell "now_s=$(date +%s); dow=$(date +%u); h=$(date +%H); m=$(date +%M); s=$(date +%S); sod=$((10#$h*3600 + 10#$m*60 + 10#$s)); mon_s=$((now_s - (dow-1)*86400 - sod)); mon_ms=$((mon_s*1000)); now_ms=$((now_s*1000)); echo MON_MS=$mon_ms NOW_MS=$now_ms; content query --uri content://de.dennisguse.opentracks.content/tracks | awk -v mon=$mon_ms -v now=$now_ms 'BEGIN{maxExact=-1;maxFuzzy=-1} { if (match($0,/activity_type=([^,]+)/,a) && match($0,/starttime=([0-9]+)/,b) && match($0,/totaldistance=([0-9.]+)/,c)) { t=a[1]; st=b[1]+0; d=c[1]+0; types[t]=1; if (st>=mon && st<=now) { if (t=="mountain biking" && d>maxExact) maxExact=d; tl=tolower(t); if (index(tl,"mountain") && index(tl,"bik")) if (d>maxFuzzy) maxFuzzy=d; } } } END{ printf("MAX_EXACT=%.0f
",maxExact); printf("MAX_FUZZY=%.0f
",maxFuzzy); printf("TYPES="); first=1; for (k in types){ if(!first) printf("|"); printf("%s",k); first=0 } printf("
") }'"
